ps3.6:2.2: idha bhikkhave, ekacco anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhoti:
ps3.6:2.3: ekopi hutvā bahudhā hoti, bahudhāpi hutvā eko hoti,
ps3.6:3.3: “evampi te mano, itthampi te mano, itipi te citta’nti.
ps3.6:3.4: so bahuṃ ceva ādisati, tatheva taṃ hoti, no aññathā
ps3.6:3.5: idha pana bhikkhave, ekacco na heva kho nimittena ādisati, api ca kho manussānaṃ vā amanussānaṃ vā devatānaṃ vā saddaṃ sutvā ādisati:
ps3.6:3.6: ‘evampi te mano, itthampi te mano, itipi te citta’nti.
ps3.6:3.7: so bahuṃ cepi ādisati, tatheva taṃ hoti, no aññathā.
ps3.6:3.8: idha pana bhikkhave, ekacco na heva kho nimittena ādisati, napi manussānaṃ vā amanussānaṃ vā devatānaṃ vā saddaṃ sutvā ādisati, api ca kho vitakkayato vicārayato vitakkavipphārasaddaṃ sutvā ādisati:
ps3.6:3.9: ‘evampi te mano, itthampi te mano, itipi te citta’nti.
ps3.6:3.10: so bahuṃ cepi ādisati, tatheva taṃ hoti, no aññathā.
ps3.6:3.11: idha pana bhikkhave, ekacco na heva kho nimittena ādisati, napi manussānaṃ vā amanussānaṃ vā devatānaṃ vā saddaṃ sutvā ādisati: napi vitakkayato, vicārayato vitakkavipphārasaddaṃ sutvā ādisati, api ca kho avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhiṃ samāpannassa cetasā ceto paricca pajānāti:
ps3.6:3.12: ‘yathā imassa bhoto manosaṅkhārā paṇihitā imassa cittassa anantarā amukaṃ nāma vitakkaṃ vitakkayisasti’ti
ps3.6:3.13: so bahuṃ cepi ādisati, tatheva taṃ hoti, no aññathā.
ps3.6:5.3: ye tena nekkhammena samannāgatā, sabbe te visuddhacittā anāvilasaṅkappāti
ps3.6:5.5: taṃ kho pana nekkhammaṃ ‘evaṃ āsevitabbaṃ, evaṃ bhāvetabbaṃ, evaṃ bahulīkātabbaṃ, evaṃ tadanudhammatā sati upaṭṭhāpetabbā’ti
ps3.6:6.3: ye tena abyāpādena samannāgatā, sabbe te visuddhacittā anāvilasaṅkappāti
ps3.6:6.5: so kho pana abyāpādo evaṃ āsevitabbo, evaṃ bhāvetabbo, evaṃ bahulīkātabbo, evaṃ tadanudhammatā sati upaṭṭhāpetabbā’ti
ps3.6:7.3: ye tāya ālokasaññāya samannāgatā, sabbe te visuddhacittā anāvilasaṅkappāti
ps3.6:7.5: sā kho pana ālokasaññā evaṃ āsevitabbaṃ, evaṃ bhāvetabbaṃ, evaṃ bahulīkātabbaṃ, evaṃ tadanudhammatā sati upaṭṭhāpetabbā’ti
ps3.6:8.3: ye tena avikkhepena samannāgatā, sabbe te visuddhacittā anāvilasaṅkappāti
ps3.6:8.5: so kho pana avikkhepo ‘evaṃ āsevitabbo, evaṃ bhāvetabbo, evaṃ bahulīkātabbo, evaṃ tadanudhammatā sati upaṭṭhāpetabbā’ti
ps3.6:9.3: ‘ye tena dhammavavatthānena samannāgatā, sabbe te visuddhacittā anāvilasaṅkappā’ti
ps3.6:9.5: taṃ kho pana dhammavavatthānaṃ ‘evaṃ āsevitabbaṃ, evaṃ bhāvetabbaṃ, evaṃ bahulīkātabbaṃ, evaṃ tadanudhammatā sati upaṭṭhāpetabbā’ti
ps3.6:10.3: ye tena ñāṇena samannāgatā, sabbe te visuddhacittā anāvilasaṅkappāti
ps3.6:10.5: taṃ kho pana ñāṇaṃ evaṃ āsevitabbaṃ, evaṃ bhāvetabbaṃ, evaṃ bahulīkātabbaṃ, evaṃ tadanudhammatā sati upaṭṭhāpetabbā’ti
ps3.6:11.3: ‘ye tena pāmojjena samannāgatā, sabbe te visuddhacittā anāvilasaṅkappā’ti
ps3.6:11.5: taṃ kho pana pāmojjaṃ ‘evaṃ āsevitabbaṃ, evaṃ bhāvetabbaṃ, evaṃ bahulīkātabbaṃ, evaṃ tadanudhammatā sati upaṭṭhāpetabbā’ti
ps3.6:12.3: ye tena paṭhamena jhānena samannāgatā, sabbe te visuddhacittā anāvilasaṅkappāti
ps3.6:12.5: taṃ kho pana paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ ‘evaṃ āsevitabbaṃ, evaṃ bhāvetabbaṃ, evaṃ bahulīkātabbaṃ, evaṃ tadanudhammatā sati upaṭṭhāpetabbā’ti
ps3.6:13.3: ‘ye tena arahattamaggena samannāgatā, sabbe te visuddhacittā anāvilasaṅkappāti
ps3.6:13.5: so kho pana arahattamaggo ‘evaṃ āsevitabbaṃ, evaṃ bhāvetabbo, evaṃ bahulīkātabbo, evaṃ tadanudhammatā sati upaṭṭhāpetabbā’ti
ps3.6:14.3: yā ca iddhi yañca pāṭihāriyaṃ, idaṃ vuccati iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ.
